description: Charging Station Environment - Dataset is a data set deposited in Mendeley Data by its authors Rémi Gauchotte, Ammar Oulamara (Universite de Lorraine). The generated charging station data and the results obtained for the electric vehicles charging scheduling problem with admission decision and photovoltaic panels production. Coverage: a single site or case study; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-mendeley-repository.
